Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Amber Metal Buffet Table Kitchen Storage Rack, 47.5"W, White, Carrera Marble, Black Metal
Colors: White
Materials: Iron
You'll get handsome design along with functionality in this baker's rack. The shelves on the top and bottom can be removed to accommodate taller items, while the main shelf is a beautiful carrera marble that will add sophistication to your kitchen. 24"L x 47.5"W x 72"H Metal with black finish; marble A transitional piece that works with any décor Shelves can be removed to adapt to your storage needs Assembly in an hour or less Free return for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
